api_findings.package_write_audit: QualiaDB PackageWriteIntent / PackageWriteEvidence / NativeAuthority::package_write_evidence; does not grant review or HMC acceptance
api_findings.package_persistence: Poet CheckpointService::save_with_resource_edits and PackageWritePolicy; digest-bound working-copy/release handling
api_findings.hmc_reopen: CheckpointService::prepare_reopen + activate; owner guard, source binding and fresh disk digest recheck
api_findings.native_route: LaunchAction::GrantReview -> native_entry::actions::grant_review -> enrollment_permission + authority_signer + admitted/unrevoked subject + configured document scope + grant_enrollment_review; validity capped by reviewer and snapshot expiry.
api_findings.revoke: LaunchAction::Revoke calls revoke_enrollment; current UI describes enrollment revocation, not grant-only revocation.

required_next_action: Implement canonical package review bound to exact HMC/package digest and full resource inventory, using separate reviewer authority and durable package-decision evidence. Existing source-review grant route is already present; grant-only revocation is a separate scoped question.
